name: Gilded Tern gangway gate
notes: The gate at the head of the Gilded Tern's gangway (mw-e40.1, route is mw-e40.14): Captain Hesketh's crew keep it until the debt of honour or the crew deal opens it (hesketh.gangway-open). Tier 3, cannot be picked.
hint: The crew keep the gangway. Ask the Captain.
